Class CdcEventDecoder

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.cdc.CdcEventDecoder
public final class CdcEventDecoder extends Object
Parses CockroachDB changefeed webhook bodies into CdcEnvelopes and decodes their payloads into application-facing CdcEvents. Thread-safe: the underlying Jackson ObjectMapper is safe for concurrent reads.
